The 'mql' arm goes to Delegate 'mql' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Mql Contact - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Mql Contact before relying on that arm.
